claims.claim: NASA released its October Artemis Update covering SLS status, a lighter sortie spacesuit, and two parallel lunar delivery architectures.
claims.episode_span: The October Artemis Update covered near-term status of the Space Launch System, a lighter sortie version of the lunar spacesuit, and two parallel architectures for delivering astronauts to the lunar surface.
claims.source_title: Overview of NASA Artemis Acceleration media event updates
claims.supporting_quote: NASA released its October Artemis Update on Friday, covering the near-term status of the Space Launch System (SLS), a lighter “sortie” version of the lunar spacesuit, and two parallel architectures for delivering astronauts to the lunar surface.

claims.claim: Artemis III remains targeted for no earlier than summer 2027 as a 14-day low-Earth-orbit risk-reduction mission.
claims.episode_span: Artemis III remains targeted for no earlier than summer 2027 as a 14-day low-Earth-orbit risk-reduction mission.
claims.source_title: Overview of NASA Artemis Acceleration media event updates
claims.supporting_quote: Artemis III is the low-Earth-orbit mission inserted into the manifest earlier this year. It is targeted for no earlier than summer 2027.

claims.claim: Falcon 9 booster B1063 completed its 36th mission on the Starlink Group 15-15 launch from Vandenberg.
claims.episode_span: The launch lifted 27 Starlink satellites from SLC-4E at 6:48 p.m. EDT, with the first stage landing on the droneship Of Course I Still Love You.
claims.source_title: SpaceX launches Starlink satellites from California as Falcon 9 cadence slows (photos)
claims.supporting_quote: The booster, meanwhile, reoriented for its descent back to Earth. As the mission clock passed 8 minutes, B1063 began its landing burn, and it touched down about 20 seconds later on SpaceX’s droneship "Of Course I Still Love You." This was the 36th launch and landing for B1063

claims.claim: The mission adds another national-security payload in a market where Starshield also competes.
claims.episode_span: The mission adds another national-security payload in a market where Starshield also competes.

claims.episode_span: Cursor CLI runs the same agent from any shell in GitHub Actions, passing a prompt and model name to complete tasks without a window or keyboard input.
